items.title: How big is the overconfidence gap, and how does it change as stated confidence rises?
items.description: Ben says '90% confident it'll rain' and it actually rains only about 58% of the time — a 32-point overconfidence gap. Rosa's actual hit rate stays close to whatever she states. Fix an actual hit rate (how often reality really matches, based on real track record) and drag stated confidence up or down to see how the gap between what's said and what's true opens or closes.
items.compute: const gap = params.statedConfidencePercent - params.actualHitRatePercent; return { calibrationGap: gap };

items.title: How many predict-and-check cycles does it actually take to close a calibration gap?
items.description: Tomás started at a 30-point calibration gap in month 1 and had nearly closed it by month 4, logging about 6 predictions a month. Assume the gap closes with fast early progress that tapers off — each additional logged prediction helps, but less than the one before it. Drag the number of logged predict-and-check cycles to see how the remaining gap shrinks, and how much slower the later cycles help compared to the first few.
items.compute: const startingGap = 30; const rate = 0.06; const remainingGap = startingGap * Math.exp(-rate * params.cyclesLogged); return { remainingGap: Math.round(remainingGap * 10) / 10 };
